abstract.t: This document defines the moqt URI scheme, URI resolution mechanisms, and discovery methods for the Media over QUIC Transport (MOQT) protocol. It specifies the URI syntax, fragment identifiers, dereferencing procedures, normalization rules, and X.509 certificate matching for moqt URIs. It also defines DNS-based resolution using SVCB and SRV records, as well as local network discovery via mDNS and DNS-SD.
